jobs.title: নন-ক্যাডার নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.qualification: 4-year Diploma in Computer Engineering from a recognized polytechnic institute (Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Software diplomas also accepted for this post). Aptitude test required. Age up to 32.
jobs.note: This BPSC non-cadre circular covers 147 posts in 19 categories — of them, this is the post open to you: Sub-Assistant Maintenance Engineer accepts a 4-year Diploma in Computer Engineering. Apply online at bpsc.teletalk.com.bd and pay the ৳200 fee by Teletalk.

jobs.title: পুরান মোগলটুলি উচ্চ বিদ্যালয়ে নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি
jobs.org: Purana Mogaltuli High School (Dhaka South City Corporation)
jobs.qualification: ICT Teacher: a BTEB 3-year Diploma in Computer Science is accepted (as an alternative to a Computer Science degree). Computer Lab Operator: BTEB 3-year Computer Diploma, or HSC (Science) with ICT. Age up to 35 (as of 1 Dec 2026).
jobs.salary: ICT Teacher: Grade-10 ৳16,000–38,640 / Grade-11 ৳12,500–30,230 • Lab Operator: Grade-16 ৳9,300–22,490
jobs.note: Both posts accept your BTEB Diploma in Computer Science. This application is NOT online: send a written application by post to the Head Teacher, Purana Mogaltuli High School, so it arrives by the deadline (12 Dec 2026).

jobs.title: পেট্রোবাংলা নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.org: Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla)
jobs.qualification: 4-year Diploma-in-Engineering in Computer Technology from a government-approved institute — the circular's exact requirement for this post. Age up to 32 (as of 1 Sep 2026).
jobs.fee: ৳223 (Teletalk) — ৳56 for ethnic minority, disabled and third-gender applicants
jobs.note: This circular (memo 28.02.0000.000.011.26.0027.26.453, 29 Sep 2026) covers 753 posts in 36 categories at Petrobangla and its companies — of them, this is the post open to you: Sub-Assistant Engineer (Computer/IT), 8 posts. At BGFCL the same post is titled Assistant Technical Officer. The deadline was extended from 17 Nov to 30 Nov 2026 (5:00 PM). Apply online at bogmc.teletalk.com.bd and pay the fee by Teletalk SMS within 72 hours.

jobs.title: জাতীয় সংসদ সচিবালয়ে নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.qualification: Technician (Network): Diploma in Computer Science / Networking / Electrical Engineering / Information Technology. Technician (Hardware): Diploma in Computer Science / Hardware / Electrical Engineering / Information Technology. (Both wordings are from the circular itself.) Age 18–32 (as of 12 Nov 2026). One candidate may apply for only ONE post in this circular — choose Network or Hardware.
jobs.note: Circular no. 11.00.0000.000.804.11.0004.26.646 (10 Nov 2026) advertises 155 posts in 28 categories at the Parliament Secretariat, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka — the two Technician posts above are the ones open to Diploma in Computer holders. Apply online at bps.teletalk.com.bd and pay ৳112 by Teletalk SMS within 72 hours. Posts are temporary under the revenue budget.

jobs.title: খুলনা প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.posts: উপ-সহকারী প্রোগ্রামার (Sub-Assistant Programmer), Central Computer Centre
jobs.qualification: Diploma in the relevant technology from an approved board — the circular's first qualification option, and a Diploma in Computer is the relevant technology for this post; practical experience running different software is preferred. (The circular also allows a science degree + 1-year computer training + 3 years' experience, or a BSc Engineering degree.) Age 18–32, counted on 18 Oct 2026; no 3rd class/division at any level.
jobs.note: Apply on KUET's own job portal: create an account, fill in your profile once, then apply for the post and pay the ৳800 fee online (card or mobile banking). This circular (memo খুপ্রবি/সওপ্র/১৪৯৬/১০০, 18 Oct 2026) advertises 62 posts — this Sub-Assistant Programmer post at the Central Computer Centre is the one open to Diploma in Computer holders.

jobs.title: বাংলাদেশ পেট্রোলিয়াম কর্পোরেশন নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.posts: উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী (পরিকল্পনা ও উন্নয়ন) — ১টি • উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী (সাধারণ কর্মশাখা) — ১টি
jobs.qualification: Diploma in Engineering — the circular requires only 'ডিপ্লোমা ডিগ্রিধারী প্রকৌশলী' (Diploma degree holder engineer) with no technology named, so a Diploma in Computer Engineering qualifies. Relevant experience is an added qualification. Age up to 32 (as of 19 Dec 2026). One candidate may apply for only ONE post in this circular.
jobs.note: This circular (memo 28.03.0000.000.010.04.0001.17.52, 19 Nov 2026) covers 19 posts in 14 categories at BPC, Chattogram — of them, these two Sub-Assistant Engineer posts are the ones open to Diploma in Engineering holders. Apply online at bpc.teletalk.com.bd and pay the ৳223 fee by Teletalk SMS within 72 hours.

jobs.title: বাংলাদেশ শিক্ষাতথ্য ও পরিসংখ্যান ব্যুরো (ব্যানবেইস) নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি ২০২৬
jobs.org: Bangladesh Bureau of Educational Information and Statistics (BANBEIS)
jobs.qualification: SSC or equivalent + Diploma in Computer Engineering + 1 year relevant work experience. Age 18–60 (as of 26 Nov 2026).
jobs.salary: মাসিক সেবা মূল্য ৳20,212 (fixed monthly service fee — not a pay scale)
jobs.note: This is an OUTSOURCING service contract, NOT a permanent government post: 2-year term from 1 Jan 2027 (subject to Finance Division approval), monthly service fee ৳20,212, and appointees get no priority for any permanent BANBEIS post. Circular memo 37.20.0000.001.11.331.26 (Part-2)/498, 9 Nov 2026, covers 273 service workers in 14 categories — of them, only the Server Technician post (1) is open to Diploma in Computer Engineering holders. This application is NOT online: download the form from banbeis.gov.bd and send it directly or by post to the Director General, BANBEIS, 1 Zahir Raihan Road (Palashi-Nilkhet), Dhaka-1205, so it arrives by 26 Nov 2026, 4:00 PM. One candidate may apply for only one post.
